first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior acquisition and revenue evidence. However, its effect on sustainable qualified revenue is unclear without the archived record, particularly retention, discount dependency, and cohort quality. Verify memory_73 as the leading option and memory_86 as the strongest non-discount alternative given the onboarding decline and its potential to improve time-to-value without price erosion.

final.rationale: Run a controlled experiment shortening onboarding. The verified record shows higher completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and positive 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing because its qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower retention and failure at first renewal. A broad rollout is premature because the cause of the current decline remains uncertain.
